verdict.rationale: Ramp documents Funds/budgets with amount, interval, merchant/category/country restrictions (ramp-docs-41, ramp-supp-spend-controls-agents), per-team/per-vendor virtual card issuance with spending limits (ramp-docs-11, ramp-docs-31), pre-spend enforcement including blocking risky merchants/categories and submission requirements (ramp-docs-9), policy-grounded approval recommendations (ramp-docs-10), role/spend-amount-based notification workflows (ramp-docs-12), and multi-entity consolidated policy/control management (ramp-docs-42). This covers allocation-to-enforcement across cards, approvals, and budgets. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that limits are actually enforced in production (vs. marketing copy) and more detail on hierarchical team/project budget rollups.
